agentNotProjectMember: AI teammates can't be added as project members. A project's agents are managed in its agent settings, not in the member list.
projectManageForbidden: Only the project owner or a team admin can manage this project
peopleJoinByInvite: People join a project by invitation. This only adds seats for AI teammates
leaveProjectSignIn: Sign in to leave the project
ownerCannotLeave: The project owner can't leave the project. Transfer it to someone else first
inviteSelf: You don't need to invite yourself
inviteAlreadyMember: This person is already in the project (team members don't need an invitation)
invitePending: This person has already been invited and hasn't answered yet
inviteAnswered: This invitation has already been answered
inviteNotYours: Only the invited person can answer this invitation
